## Dough Intent Coverage: SEED-275#story-intent-tabs

**Outcome: Caught.**

- **Story and revision.** SEED-275#story-intent-tabs (`.planning/seeds/SEED-275-story-intent-tabs.md#story-intent-tabs`) at 2c3f18105b57ce6f6a0c325a635b19a5366f3dcd, checked in an isolated detached scratch worktree (clean pre-probe state, 0 changed paths).
- **Promise.** Key example 1 and scope: "The title appears once and the default tab shows the comparison as soon as CI is available", and "CI can appear while file locations are still loading" (plan slice 1: CI evidence arrives in the default panel before the location read is released; source-review commitments G1 and 7).
- **Fault.** `dashboard/src/IntentStoryView.tsx`, the CI comparison tab panel: `<IntentCiStatus />` became `{shown.settled && <IntentCiStatus />}`, so CI waits for the Intent locations read to settle. Fixture and assertions unchanged.
- **Fixture.** `holdLocationsOfComparedStory` in `dashboard/tests/intent/intent-ci-comparison-locations.spec.ts`: a compared done Story A whose authenticated `intent=locations` read is held from the start (`holdAuthenticatedReadsWhere`), selected through `selectDoneStoryForCiComparison`.
- **Maintained assertion.** Test "a selected story's CI comparison shows under its one header while the Intent locations read is held…", line 67–69: `expect(intent.getByRole("tabpanel", { name: "CI comparison" })).toContainText("Baseline compared with Landed")`.
- **Run observations.**
  - Baseline: `npm run test:dashboard -- tests/intent/intent-ci-comparison-locations.spec.ts --workers=2 --reporter=line`: 2 passed, both tests ran.
  - Faulted: 2 failed. In the selected test, `locations.held() > 0`, the CI comparison tab, the single title and the single summary all passed first. The intended assertion then failed with `Expected substring: "Baseline compared with Landed"` and `Received string: ""`, so the CI comparison panel was empty. The test timed out while still on that assertion. The hold is released only at line 81, after that assertion, so the panel was empty because of the fault while the locations read was held. The sibling failed-read test also failed while the read was still held. Its failure came earlier, in the shared helper's `CI timing comparison` region visibility wait (`selectDoneStoryForCiComparison.ts:28`, element not found), which is further evidence that CI no longer appeared while locations were pending. One oddity: in the selected test that helper wait passed even though the panel text was empty at line 69. The page snapshot captured after teardown released the hold shows the CI comparison rendered, which matches CI appearing only after the locations settle.
  - Restoration: the edit ran under a shell `trap` that runs `git checkout -- dashboard/src/IntentStoryView.tsx`. Afterwards `git status --porcelain` matched the recorded empty pre-probe state and `git diff` was empty. Rerunning the same command passed 2 of 2.
- **Cleanup.** Removed the scratch worktree with `git worktree remove --force`. No test process of this check outlived its run. The stash stack and the execution checkout were not touched.

### Cost

- **Test runtime (measured).** Playwright-reported runtime: baseline 25.3 s, faulted run about 30 s per test at the 30 s test timeout (32.0 s command wall clock), restored 12.9 s. Wall clock per command: 27.5 s, 32.0 s and 13.3 s.
- **Human effort.** Unavailable: no human took part in the check, and there is no separate measure.
- **Agent effort.** Unavailable: no separately supported measure of agent tokens or active time is available to this agent.


- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 171517 ms (measured), from 1794152103157 to 1794152274674 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.
